verses.1: And the LORD said to Moses and to Aaron, son of Aaron, the priest:
verses.2: Bring forth the heads of all the tribes of Israel, from those who are twenty years old and above, to go into the houses of their fathers. All the leaders of Israel must be brought forward.
verses.3: And Moses and the priest Eleazar spoke to them in the evening at Mount Sinai.
verses.4: From the age of forty years upward, as Jehovah commanded Moses and the children of Israel who came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.5: Reuven, son of Israel, was a descendant of Reuven from the family of Hanokh. He belonged to the tribe of Paluai.
verses.6: To the garden of the family of the vineyard, from the family of the vineyard.
verses.7: These are the descendants of my ancestors. Their number was three hundred and forty-seven thousand six hundred and thirty.
verses.8: And the sons of Phaleh Eliav.
verses.9: And the sons of Eliav were Nemuel and Dathan. Their leader was Dathan. They were the leaders of the people who obeyed Moses and Aaron in the presence of Korah.
verses.10: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them, along with the ashes of the sacrifice. In the fire, fifty thousand people died. They became dust.
verses.11: And the sons of Korah did not die.
verses.12: The sons of Shimeon were given to their families: Nimuel from the family of Nimuali, Yamin from the family of Yamini, and Yaquin from the family of Yaqini.
verses.13: To Zerah from the family of Hizrah, to Shaul from the family of Hashaul.
verses.14: These are the descendants of Shem: two hundred and ten thousand.
verses.15: The sons of Gad to their families: to the family of Tzafon, for the festival; to the family of Hagi, for the festival; and to the family of Shuni, for the festival.
verses.16: To my ears, from the family of the ears, to the cities of the family of the cities.
verses.17: From the family of Arod to Arali, from the family of Arali.
verses.18: These are the descendants of Gad. Their number is four hundred thousand and five hundred.
verses.19: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
verses.20: And the sons of Judah became the relatives of their wives: Shela from the family of Shelani, Perek from the family of Paretzi, and Zerah from the family of Zerahi.
verses.21: And the sons of Peraz became servants in the household of the family of Hecrani. They were also servants in the household of the family of Hecmali.
verses.22: These are the descendants of Judah: six hundred and seventy-five thousand five hundred.
verses.23: The sons of Issachar shall be subject to their families. The family of Tolai will be subject to the family of Puni.
verses.24: From the family of the Rebound, let them return to Shimeron; from the family of the Shemronites.
verses.25: These are the descendants of Ishmael: four hundred and sixty thousand.
verses.26: The sons of Zebulun, for their families: the Saredi family, for all those from the Eloni family. For the Yahalel family, for those from the Yahaleli family.
verses.27: These are the descendants of Zebulon, according to their clans: six hundred and fifty thousand five hundred.
verses.28: The sons of Joseph were Menashe and Ephraim.
verses.29: The sons of Manasseh were from the family of the priests. They became priests themselves. Gilad also came from the family of the Giladites.
verses.30: These are the sons of Gilad. They are descendants of the family of Eizri, and they belong to the family of Halki.
verses.31: And Asheriel from the family of Asherim, and Shechem from the family of Shikhmi.
verses.32: And destroy the family of the Shamidai, and also destroy the tribe of the Hefri.
verses.33: And Zelphachad, son of Hefer, had no sons; he only had daughters. And those daughters suffered from a disease called “Zelphachad’s disease.” They were also weak and sickly.
verses.34: These are the descendants of Manasseh, and their wives: two hundred and fifty thousand seven.
verses.35: These are the sons of Efrém, for their families: Shuthelach from the family of Shuthelchi; Beker from the family of Bakri; and Tahan from the family of Tahani.
verses.36: And these are the sons of Shutlah from the family of the Eranites.
verses.37: These are the descendants of Eفرים: two hundred and thirty thousand. And these are the descendants of Joseph, for their families.
verses.38: The sons of Benjamin shall be under the rule of their families. They will rule over the family of the Balaei, and they will rule over the family of the Ashbeli. They will also rule over the family of the Ahirani.
verses.39: To their fathers, from the family of Shupami; to their mothers, from the family of Chupami.
verses.40: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman, from the family of Ard. Naaman was from the family of Naamim.
verses.41: These are the sons of Benyamin, according to their families and tribes. Their number is five hundred and forty thousand six hundred.
verses.42: These are the sons of Dan, to their families. They belong to the family of Shuhamayim. These are the descendants of Dan, to their families.
verses.43: All of the households of Shuhami have four hundred and sixty-four thousand.
verses.44: The sons of Asher, from their families: Yimna from the family of Yimna; Yishui from the family of Yishui; and Biria from the family of Biria.
verses.45: To the children of Rephaim, for the relatives of the family of Heveri, for the rulers of the family of the rulers.
verses.46: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sharah.
verses.47: These are the descendants of Esar, according to their families: three hundred and fifty thousand four.
verses.48: The sons of Naphtali shall be among their families. They will be from the tribe of Jahazel. They will be from the tribe of Guni.
verses.49: To create a family from the family of the Izri, in order to compensate for the family of the Shilmi.
verses.50: These are the descendants of Naphtali. Their number is five hundred and forty thousand four hundred.
verses.51: These are the orders given by the children of Israel: six thousand, one thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.52: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.53: To these, the land shall be divided as an inheritance, in accordance with their number of names.
verses.54: His land will be rich in resources, but his land will also be poor in some areas. Each person will receive his own portion according to his efforts.
verses.55: But in war, the land will be divided among the descendants of their fathers. They will inherit it.
verses.56: According to the inheritance law, his share will be divided between many people, but not equally.
verses.57: And these are the decrees of the Levites for their families: to separate them from the family of Gerashni, from the family of Khatti, and from the family of Merari.
verses.58: These are the families of Levi: the family of Hilkuni, the family of Heveroni, the family of Machli, the family of Mushi, and the family of Karhi. They gave birth to Amram.
verses.59: And the name of the daughter of Amram’s wife was Jochebed. She was the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. Jochebed gave birth to Aaron, Moses, and Miriam, their sister.
verses.60: And Aaron had Nadab and Abihu, Elzab and Itamar.
verses.61: And Nadab and his father died when they offered strange fire before Jehovah.
verses.62: And their number was three hundred and ten thousand, for every male from the age of six years old upward. They did not settle among the children of Israel, because they were not given any land to live in among the children of Israel.
verses.63: These were the commands of Moses and Aaron, the priest, who commanded the children of Israel in the evening hours of Moab on the banks of the Jordan River.
verses.64: And in those days, there would be no one appointed to lead Moses and Aaron, the priests, who were responsible for leading the children of Israel across the Sea of Egypt.
verses.65: For Jehovah said to them, “They will die in the desert; no one will remain among them. Only a cat, the offspring of a cat, will survive.”
